body:
**Bug Description**
I used $10.34 of Claude Code, and have set my account limits to $100. However, the Claude Code API limit is set to $10 and I cannot change it in console settings. I am locked out of using Claude Code until 6/1/2025 which makes this integration compeltely unusable. Why can I not have complete control over how much money I want to spend? It is artificially lowered in console and I cannot change it.

- Terminal: Apple_Terminal

top_comments.body:
Hi @murflaw7424  - looks like there might be some confusion between organization and workspace limits. Looking at the screenshot above, you have a workspace limit of $10/month set, and an organization limit of $100/month. 

To update the Claude Code workspace limit, you'll need workspace admin permissions (which you don't appear to have). I recommend taking a look at the members tab in the Claude Code workspace and contacting your Workspace admin to increase your monthly limit. 

Hope that helps

top_comments.author: murflaw7424
top_comments.body: @Meahaa thank you for your reply. This is my account and I am the admin. See below screenshot, seems to be a bug.
